personal_repos.name: STANK
personal_repos.description: STANK is a programming language that I built for fun. STANK follows the concatenative paradigm, and provides both an interpreter and compiler for STANK programs. Checkout bubblesort.stanky to see a sorting algorithm written in STANK!

personal_repos.name: bitchat-relay
personal_repos.description: An ESP-based bitchat node to extend network size

personal_repos.name: NYUv2-Semantic-Segmentation
personal_repos.description: A group project which aimed at testing the effect of adding depth information to semantic segmentation. This project implements both E-Net and U-Net with and without depth with an associated paper to highlight our results.

personal_repos.name: Iris-Labs
personal_repos.description: Iris Labs is a frontend web application for building LED lighting effects to be used on the Iris driver

personal_repos.name: Iris
personal_repos.description: Iris is a LED controller for ESP32 microcontrollers and APA-102 LED lights. Iris provides a powerful paradigm for creating effects for strips of LED lights, and is the fourth iteration on my journey to create powerful customizable LED lights!

personal_repos.name: uJson
personal_repos.description: A header micro json library using no non standard dependencies. Simply copy the json header file into your project, and include "json.h"

personal_repos.name: Crank
personal_repos.description: Crank is a C++ neural network library that provides an easy to use API to build and test different neural networks and network architectures

personal_repos.name: Convert-To-Image
personal_repos.description: Convert-To-Image is a tool that allows you to convert an arbitrary file into an image. The transformation is also invertible, and thus you can convert the image back into its original data
